description: Use this when the user asks about price or cost at Horseback (ile kosztuje jazda konna, cena hipoterapii, karnet, obóz, wycieczka, strzelnica). Returns the current price list (same as https://horseback.pl/cennik): item id, activity name, price text, a link to the activity page, who it is for (audience: individual, family, kindergarten, school, wtz (occupational therapy workshop (WTZ)), company, public_office) and occasions (birthday, bachelor_party (bachelor/bachelorette party), wedding, first_communion, corporate_event (company event/team-building), school_trip, gift). To show a group the items that fit the conversation, pick them by audience and occasions and pass their ids in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer. Prices are kept as text ("od" / "from", per person, per group); "wycena indywidualna" / individual quote means the price is quoted after the inquiry - do not invent a number. Do not use to take payment - no payment is taken through these tools.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

name: get_price_list

audience.description: Who the item is for (audience): code and label in the language of the response.

buyNowUrl.description: Online payment link ("Kup teraz" / Buy now), only for items sold online; payment on site is possible too.

id.description: Stable id of the price-list item (pass it in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer).

occasions.description: Occasions the item fits (may be empty): code and label in the language of the response.

price.description: Price as text, e.g. "od 100 zł / os." or "wycena indywidualna".

title: Cennik
